info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Emerald Syrup Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Emerald Syrup Detail Management API enables businesses to efficiently create and manage detailed records of emerald syrup products within their catalog. This API allows users to input essential information, ensuring that all relevant product details are stored systematically. Typical consumers include product managers and inventory systems that require updated syrup data for inventory tracking and sales. By utilizing this endpoint, organizations can streamline their catalog management processes and improve product visibility.

post.summary: Create details for the Emerald Syrup product.
post.description: This operation allows you to create detailed information about the Emerald Syrup product, including features, specifications, and usage instructions. Ensure that all necessary details are provided in the request body to accurately reflect the product's attributes.

requestBody.description: This request body is designed to submit details related to the emerald syrup. It should contain all necessary fields as defined in the schema to ensure the proper processing of the request.

200.description: Successful request processing with details returned.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority or not.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the emerald syrup.

tags.description: A list of tags associated with the request for categorization.

items.description: A tag for categorizing the syrup request.
